models.name: shopping_mall_channels
models.description:
Represents sales channels (e.g., online store, mobile app) with branding, configuration, and settings for multi-channel operations.

Each channel defines a distinct storefront experience with its own branding, language, currency, and operational parameters.
Administrators create and manage multiple channels to serve different markets, platforms, or customer segments with tailored experiences.

Channels can be enabled or disabled independently, allowing fine-grained control over which storefronts are active.
All channel settings are applied at the platform infrastructure level, influencing how products are displayed, how payments are routed, and how orders are processed across different sales avenues.

Channels do not store business data directly but provide the configuration context for all other business entities.

plainFields.name: name
plainFields.description: Human-readable name of the sales channel (e.g., 'Online Store', 'Mobile App', 'Wholesale Portal').

plainFields.name: description
plainFields.description: Detailed description explaining the channel's purpose and target audience.

plainFields.name: logo_url
plainFields.description: URL pointing to the channel's logo image for branding in UI.

plainFields.name: color_scheme
plainFields.description: CSS color scheme definition for the channel's visual theme (e.g., '#FF0000, #0000FF' for red and blue).

plainFields.name: theme
plainFields.description: UI theme identifier for the channel (e.g., 'light', 'dark', 'retro').

plainFields.name: timezone
plainFields.description: IANA timezone identifier for the channel's operations (e.g., 'America/New_York', 'Asia/Seoul').

plainFields.name: currency
plainFields.description: ISO 4217 currency code for pricing display and processing (e.g., 'USD', 'KRW', 'EUR').

plainFields.name: language
plainFields.description: ISO 639-1 language code for UI text (e.g., 'en', 'ko', 'ja').

plainFields.name: enabled
plainFields.description: Whether this channel is active and visible to users. False means channel is disabled but preserved for audit.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the channel was created.

plainFields.name: updated_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the channel was last updated.

plainFields.name: deleted_at
plainFields.description: Soft delete timestamp; null means channel is active, value means channel is archived.

models.name: shopping_mall_sections
models.description:
Hierarchical sections within channels for organizing products and content, enabling multi-level navigation and content grouping.

Defines the tree structure of content sections within each sales channel (e.g., online store, mobile app). Sections can be nested to create multi-level navigation menus, with each section having a specific order within its parent.

This table is used to build the content hierarchy that products and categories are assigned to, determining how users discover and browse offerings on the platform. It is a foundational system configuration component maintained by administrators.

Sections are not directly accessible by customers or sellers but serve as organizational containers for product categorization and content presentation.

foreignFields.name: shopping_mall_channel_id
foreignFields.description: Parent channel this section belongs to. {@link shopping_mall_channels.id}.

foreignFields.name: parent_id
foreignFields.description: Parent section for hierarchical nesting. {@link shopping_mall_sections.id}.

plainFields.name: name
plainFields.description: Display name of the section used in navigation menus and UI.

plainFields.name: description
plainFields.description: Detailed description explaining the purpose and scope of this section for administrators.

plainFields.name: ordering
plainFields.description: Display order of this section within its parent section or channel root. Lower values appear first.

models.name: shopping_mall_configurations
models.description:
System-wide configuration settings, feature flags, and platform-wide operational parameters that control core behavior.

Stores key-value configuration pairs that define platform behavior, enable/disable features, and set operational thresholds. These settings are managed exclusively by administrators through the admin dashboard and apply globally across all system components. Configurations support multiple data types (string, number, boolean, json) to accommodate diverse system parameters such as payment gateway timeouts, default shipping methods, feature toggles, and rate limits.

Configuration keys are unique and immutable in naming, but the values can be updated by admins as needed. The system retrieves configurations at startup and caches them to avoid database latency during request processing. Changes to configurations require admin authentication and are audited through the platform's admin audit system.

plainFields.name: key
plainFields.description: Unique identifier for the configuration setting (e.g., "payment_gateway_timeout", "feature_flag_new_checkout"). Must be globally unique across all configurations.

plainFields.name: value
plainFields.description: String representation of the configuration value. Can encode string, number, boolean, or JSON values. For numeric/boolean values, the string representation follows standard conversion rules (e.g., "true", "42", "{\"enabled\":true}").

plainFields.name: type
plainFields.description: Data type classification of the configuration value. Valid values: "string", "number", "boolean", "json". Determines how the value should be interpreted and parsed by the application.

plainFields.name: updated_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when this configuration was last modified. Tracks when admins last changed the value. No automatic update on read operations.

models.name: shopping_mall_customers
models.description:
Primary entity representing registered customers who can browse products, add items to cart, place orders, manage shipping addresses, view order history, write reviews, and create wishlists.

Stores authenticated customer identities with secure credentials and personal information. Each customer has a unique email address and password hash for secure login. This table serves as the foundation for all customer interactions with the e-commerce platform.

Customers can create multiple sessions, place multiple orders, submit reviews, create wishlists, and manage multiple shipping addresses - all linked through foreign key relationships. This table is the central identity record for all user-facing functionality and requires independent CRUD operations for account management.

The soft delete pattern is implemented to maintain audit trails while allowing account deactivation.

plainFields.name: email
plainFields.description: Unique email address for customer authentication. Must be valid and unique across all users.

plainFields.name: password_hash
plainFields.description: Hashed password for authentication. Never stored as plain text. Required for login functionality.

plainFields.name: first_name
plainFields.description: Customer's first name for personalization and communication purposes.

plainFields.name: last_name
plainFields.description: Customer's last name for personalization and communication purposes.

plainFields.name: phone
plainFields.description: Optional phone number for SMS notifications and order updates.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the customer account was created.

plainFields.name: updated_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the customer account was last updated.

plainFields.name: deleted_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the customer account was soft-deleted. Null means account is active.

models.name: shopping_mall_sellers
models.description:
Primary entity representing business sellers who manage product inventories, listings, and order fulfillments.

Represents business accounts that register to sell products on the marketplace. Each seller has a unique identity with business name, verification status, and contact information. Sellers manage their own product catalogs, respond to customer questions and reviews, handle order fulfillment, and view sales analytics.

This entity is distinct from customers and admins. Registered sellers can create products, update inventory, fulfill orders, and manage their business dashboard. Sellers require email authentication and password storage for secure access.

plainFields.name: email
plainFields.description: Business email address used for authentication and communication. Must be unique across all sellers.

plainFields.name: password_hash
plainFields.description: BCrypt-hashed password for authenticating seller login. Never stored as plain text.

plainFields.name: name
plainFields.description: Legal or registered business name used for official transactions and communications.

plainFields.name: store_name
plainFields.description: Brand name displayed to customers on the marketplace, which may differ from the legal business name.

plainFields.name: description
plainFields.description: Detailed description of the seller's business, products, or brand values displayed on store page.

plainFields.name: logo_url
plainFields.description: URL pointing to the seller's brand logo image displayed on product listings and store page.

plainFields.name: is_verified
plainFields.description: Indicates whether the seller's business identity has been verified by platform administrators using submitted documentation.

plainFields.name: is_active
plainFields.description: Determines if the seller account is currently active and can create listings or receive orders. Set to false when suspended.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the seller account was registered and created in the system.

plainFields.name: updated_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp of the most recent update to the seller's profile information.

plainFields.name: deleted_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the seller account was soft-deleted (flagged as inactive). Null indicates active account.

models.name: shopping_mall_admins
models.description:
Primary entity representing platform administrators with full system control and moderation privileges.

Administrators have unrestricted access to manage users, products, orders, configurations, and compliance settings. This table stores essential authentication and identity information for system operators. Unlike regular users, admins can be created, modified, or suspended by other administrators through dedicated administrative workflows.

Each admin account is linked to a unique, verified email and must authenticate with a password hash. All operations performed by admins are captured in audit logs, and soft deletion is supported to preserve audit trails while enabling access revocation.

plainFields.name: email
plainFields.description: Unique email address used for administrative login and communication. Must be verified and globally unique across all users.

plainFields.name: password_hash
plainFields.description: BCrypt password hash for authentication. Never stores plain text passwords. Required for all admin login sessions.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the admin account was created. Immutable after creation.

plainFields.name: updated_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp of the last update to the admin account. Updated on every profile or credential modification.

plainFields.name: deleted_at
plainFields.description: Soft delete timestamp. When set, the admin account is considered deactivated and cannot authenticate. Used for access revocation while preserving audit trail.

models.name: shopping_mall_customer_sessions
models.description:
Authentication sessions for customers, tracking login state, IP addresses, and device context for security and audit purposes.

Each session represents a single authentication instance for a customer, used to maintain state across HTTP requests. Sessions are automatically created upon successful login and expire based on inactivity or manual logout. No customer directly manages their sessions - they are handled by the authentication system.

The session record includes connection metadata (IP, referrer, href) to support security analysis and fraud detection. It links to the customer entity via customer_id, ensuring accountability. Expired sessions are cleaned system-wide but never deleted to preserve audit trails.

Sessions are managed exclusively through authentication flows - customers cannot create, update, or delete sessions directly. This table serves purely as an audit and security mechanism within the Actors component.

foreignFields.name: customer_id
foreignFields.description: The customer who owns this authentication session. {@link shopping_mall_customers.id}.

plainFields.name: ip
plainFields.description: Client's IP address at time of session creation, used for security monitoring and geolocation.

plainFields.name: href
plainFields.description: The URL (href) from which the user initiated this authentication session.

plainFields.name: referrer
plainFields.description: The referrer URL that led the user to the authentication endpoint, useful for detecting organic vs. advertising traffic.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when this session was created during successful login.

plainFields.name: expired_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when this session expired due to inactivity, logout, or timeout. Null indicates active session.

models.name: shopping_mall_seller_sessions
models.description:
Authentication sessions for sellers, tracking login state, device context, and connection details.

Each session represents an isolated authentication context for a seller during their interaction with the platform. Sessions are automatically created upon successful login and expire according to system-defined timeouts.

Sessions do not store credentials or tokens directly but maintain the connection context including IP address, URL, and referrer for security auditing and anomaly detection. Each session is linked to exactly one seller and is terminated by expiration or explicit logout.

Session data is used for security monitoring, suspicious activity detection, and authentication audit trails. Access to seller functionality is controlled through active session validation.

foreignFields.name: seller_id
foreignFields.description: The seller who owns this authentication session. {@link shopping_mall_sellers.id}.

plainFields.name: ip
plainFields.description: The IP address from which the seller initiated this session. Used for security monitoring and location-based access control.

plainFields.name: href
plainFields.description: The URL of the page where the seller authenticated. Captures entry point for security and analytics purposes.

plainFields.name: referrer
plainFields.description: The origin URL that directed the seller to the authentication page. Used to identify traffic sources and potential phishing attempts.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when this session was created at the time of successful authentication.

plainFields.name: expired_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when this session will expire. Sessions automatically terminate after this time unless refreshed.

models.name: shopping_mall_admin_sessions
models.description:
Authentication sessions for administrators, tracking login state, tokens, and device context.

Tracks active and recently expired administrative sessions for audit and security monitoring purposes. Each session is tied to one specific administrator and records connection details including IP address, referrer, and connection URL.

Sessions are automatically expired after a configurable timeout period. The expired_at field indicates when the session ended naturally, while persisted sessions without an expired_at are considered active.

This table is managed exclusively through the authentication system and has no direct user interface. Admins do not interact with or manage these sessions directly - they are maintained by the platform's identity service.

foreignFields.name: admin_id
foreignFields.description: Administrator this session belongs to. {@link shopping_mall_admins.id}

plainFields.name: ip
plainFields.description: IP address from which the session was initiated.

plainFields.name: href
plainFields.description: URL of the connection endpoint.

plainFields.name: referrer
plainFields.description: Referrer URL that initiated this session.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when this session was created.

plainFields.name: expired_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when this session expired. Null indicates an active session.

models.name: shopping_mall_categories
models.description:
Hierarchical product categories for organizing products in catalog.

Stores the taxonomy structure of products with parent-child relationships that enable multi-level navigation. Categories form the foundation of product discovery, allowing users to browse products organized by type, function, or other meaningful groupings.

Each category can have a parent category, creating a tree structure for hierarchical classification. The category hierarchy supports drag-and-drop reordering for business users to customize catalog organization. Soft deletion is enabled to allow safe removal of categories while preserving historical references in products and orders.

foreignFields.name: parent_id
foreignFields.description: Parent category's {@link shopping_mall_categories.id}. Non-nullable to enforce hierarchy root with explicit null reference.

plainFields.name: name
plainFields.description: Display name of the category shown to customers. Max 100 characters. Must be unique within same parent level.

plainFields.name: description
plainFields.description: Detailed description of the category's purpose and contents. Used for SEO and category landing pages.

plainFields.name: ordering
plainFields.description: Position for sorting categories within parent. Lower numbers appear first. Used for manual catalog organization.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when this category was created. Standard temporal field for all business entities.

plainFields.name: updated_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when this category was last modified. Standard temporal field for all business entities.

plainFields.name: deleted_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when this category was logically deleted. Enables soft deletion for moderation purposes.

models.name: shopping_mall_products
models.description:
Core product entities with metadata including title, description, status, images, and primary category reference.

Represents individual products offered for sale on the platform. Each product serves as a catalog entry that can have multiple variants (SKUs) defined in the shopping_mall_product_variants table. Product metadata is displayed during customer browsing, search, and filtering operations.

Products maintain relationship with primary shopping_mall_categories and optionally with multiple shopping_mall_product_secondary_categories for improved discoverability. Product status determines visibility to customers. The associated shopping_mall_product_images collection defines the visual representation.

Soft deletion is enabled to allow content moderation without permanent data loss. Audit trail of changes is maintained through update_at timestamp.

foreignFields.name: shopping_mall_category_id
foreignFields.description: Primary category this product belongs to. {@link shopping_mall_categories.id}.

plainFields.name: name
plainFields.description: Product display name shown to customers.

plainFields.name: description
plainFields.description: Detailed product description explaining features, specification, and usage instructions.

plainFields.name: status
plainFields.description: Current product visibility status. Valid values: active, inactive, draft, discontinued.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the product record was initially created.

plainFields.name: updated_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the product record was last modified.

plainFields.name: deleted_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the product was logically deleted (soft delete). Null indicates active record.

models.name: shopping_mall_product_secondary_categories
models.description:
Junction table linking products to secondary categories for improved discoverability.

This table establishes a many-to-many relationship between products and secondary categories, enabling products to belong to multiple category paths beyond their primary category. This facilitates flexible product organization and enhanced user navigation in the product catalog.

Each record represents a single association between a product and a secondary category, with no additional attributes beyond the foreign keys. This ensures strict normalization and prevents data redundancy. The table is managed exclusively through product management interfaces and does not require direct user interaction.

foreignFields.name: shopping_mall_product_id
foreignFields.description: Product being associated with a secondary category. {@link shopping_mall_products.id}.

foreignFields.name: shopping_mall_category_id
foreignFields.description: Secondary category that this product belongs to. {@link shopping_mall_categories.id}.

models.name: shopping_mall_product_attributes
models.description:
Definable attribute types for product variants such as color, size, material, and other product characteristics.

Each attribute type represents a category of product characteristics that can be assigned to products to enable variant creation. Administrators define these attribute types in the system to standardize product configuration across the catalog. Attribute types serve as the foundation for product variants, where specific combinations of attribute values create unique SKUs.

Attributes are reference data that remain stable over time and are used by product management interfaces to construct product variants. They are not directly modified by customers or sellers, but are managed by platform administrators through the administrative dashboard.

plainFields.name: name
plainFields.description: The name of the attribute type (e.g., 'Color', 'Size', 'Material'). Must be unique across all attribute types to ensure consistent identification for variant creation. Used as a display name in product configuration interfaces.

plainFields.name: description
plainFields.description: Detailed explanation of what this attribute type represents and how it should be used in product configuration. Provides guidance for administrators creating attribute values and helps ensure consistent usage across the catalog.

plainFields.name: sort_order
plainFields.description: Numeric value that determines the display order of attribute types in product configuration interfaces. Lower values appear first. This allows administrators to control the sequence in which attributes are presented to users when configuring products or variants.

models.name: shopping_mall_product_attribute_values
models.description:
Specific values for product attribute types (e.g., 'Red', 'Large', 'Cotton').

Stores the possible values that can be assigned to product attributes, enabling the creation of unique product variants. Each value is associated with a specific attribute type from shopping_mall_product_attributes and forms the building blocks for variant combinations through shopping_mall_product_variant_attributes.

This table provides the reference data that allows customers to select options like color, size, or material from predefined lists. Values are managed by administrators through product catalog tools and never directly edited by end users. The table supports text search for filtering products by attribute values in the frontend UI.

foreignFields.name: shopping_mall_product_attribute_id
foreignFields.description: Reference to the product attribute type this value belongs to. {@link shopping_mall_product_attributes.id}.

plainFields.name: value
plainFields.description: The actual attribute value (e.g., 'Red', 'Large', 'Cotton'). Must be unique per attribute type to avoid duplication.

plainFields.name: description
plainFields.description: Additional context about this attribute value when the value alone is not descriptive enough (e.g., 'Dark Red' for a color).

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp of when this attribute value was created in the system.

plainFields.name: updated_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp of the last time this attribute value was modified in the system.

models.name: shopping_mall_product_variant_attributes
models.description:
Junction table mapping each product variant to its specific attribute values (SKU to attribute-value pairs).

Defines the exact combination of attribute values that constitute each product variant. This table establishes the relationship between a product variant and the specific values of product attributes (e.g., size=Large, color=Blue) that define that variant's configuration.

Each row represents a single attribute-value assignment to a variant. This allows a product to have multiple variants with different combinations of attributes while ensuring data consistency and reducing duplication.

The table is purely associative with no business state of its own - it enables the product_variants system by providing the precise attribute definitions for each variant SKU.

foreignFields.name: product_variant_id
foreignFields.description: Product variant being configured. {@link shopping_mall_product_variants.id}.

foreignFields.name: product_attribute_value_id
foreignFields.description: Specific attribute value assigned to the variant. {@link shopping_mall_product_attribute_values.id}.

models.name: shopping_mall_product_images
models.description:
Gallery images for products including primary image and up to five additional images.

Stores digital media assets associated with products in the catalog. Each image is linked to a single product and can be designated as the primary display image for product listings. The system allows multiple images per product to provide comprehensive visual representation of products, including different angles, details, and usage scenarios.

Image URLs are stored as URIs and can reference hosted images on CDN or internal storage systems. Images undergo content moderation and may be soft-deleted based on policy violations or product updates. The primary image field indicates which image should be displayed by default in product listings and search results, ensuring consistent presentation across the platform.

foreignFields.name: shopping_mall_product_id
foreignFields.description: Reference to the product this image belongs to. {@link shopping_mall_products.id}.

plainFields.name: image_url
plainFields.description: URL of the product image stored in the media system. Must be a valid URI to image file (PNG, JPEG, GIF, WebP).

plainFields.name: image_order
plainFields.description: Display order of the image among product's images. Lower numbers shown first in product gallery. Range: 1-99.

plainFields.name: is_primary
plainFields.description: Indicates if this is the primary image for the product. Only one image per product should be marked as primary. Used for product listings and search results.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the image was first uploaded to the system.

plainFields.name: updated_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the image metadata was last modified (e.g., order or primary flag changes).

plainFields.name: deleted_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the image was soft-deleted, typically due to moderation action or product update. Null indicates active status.

models.name: shopping_mall_product_tags
models.description:
Tags for products to mark promotions, featured items, or new arrivals (e.g., 'New', 'Best Seller').

Provides metadata labels that can be assigned to products for categorization, promotional display, and enhanced filtering. Tags are managed exclusively through product management interfaces and are not independently created or modified by end users. This table enables dynamic categorization without requiring structural changes to the product catalog.

plainFields.name: name
plainFields.description: The tag name used for product categorization (e.g., 'New', 'Best Seller', 'Sale'). Must be unique within the system to avoid ambiguity in product listings.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the tag was created in the system. Used for tracking when promotional or featured status was initiated.

plainFields.name: updated_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the tag was last modified. Updated whenever the tag name is changed or its assignment to products is updated.

models.name: shopping_mall_product_reviews
models.description:
Customer reviews and ratings for products with text content and numeric ratings.

Stores feedback provided by customers who have purchased products. Each review represents a single assessment of a product, containing a numeric rating (1-5) and optional textual feedback. Reviews must be verified by the system to ensure the reviewer has completed a purchase of the product.

Reviews remain visible to all users and can be flagged for moderation. Moderators may approve, reject, or delete reviews based on community guidelines. Reviewers can edit their reviews until they are moderated. Each review is uniquely tied to both the product and the customer who created it.

The review status field indicates whether the review is pending review (moderation), approved, or rejected. Soft deletion is supported for moderation purposes while preserving audit trails.

foreignFields.name: shopping_mall_product_id
foreignFields.description: Reference to the reviewed product's {@link shopping_mall_products.id}.

foreignFields.name: shopping_mall_customer_id
foreignFields.description: Reference to the review author's {@link shopping_mall_customers.id}.

plainFields.name: rating
plainFields.description: Numerical rating given by the customer, from 1 (lowest) to 5 (highest). Must be an integer between 1 and 5 inclusive.

plainFields.name: review_text
plainFields.description: Textual content of the customer review. Must be between 50 and 2000 characters long, containing the customer's detailed feedback about the product.

plainFields.name: status
plainFields.description: Current review status: 'pending' (awaiting moderation), 'approved' (publicly visible), or 'rejected' (hidden from view).

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the review was originally submitted by the customer.

plainFields.name: updated_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the review was last modified by the customer or moderator.

plainFields.name: deleted_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the review was soft-deleted by a moderator. If null, the review is active.

models.name: shopping_mall_product_review_votes
models.description:
Tracks helpful/unhelpful votes on product reviews to surface the most valuable customer feedback.

Each vote represents a customer's assessment of whether a specific product review was helpful or unhelpful. This system enables community moderation by identifying high-quality reviews that receive multiple helpful votes, while low-quality or irrelevant reviews receive unhelpful votes. The counts of helpful versus unhelpful votes determine which reviews are prominently surfaced to other customers.

Votes are immutable once recorded - customers can only vote once per review, and votes cannot be changed or revoked. This table strictly supports the primary product_reviews entity and has no independent business operations.

foreignFields.name: shopping_mall_product_review_id
foreignFields.description: The product review being voted on. {@link shopping_mall_product_reviews.id}.

foreignFields.name: shopping_mall_customer_id
foreignFields.description: The customer who cast this vote. {@link shopping_mall_customers.id}.

plainFields.name: vote_type
plainFields.description: The type of vote cast by the customer. Valid values: 'helpful' or 'unhelpful'. Represents the customer's assessment of the review's quality.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the vote was submitted by the customer. Records when the community feedback was provided for audit and sorting purposes.

models.name: shopping_mall_product_questions
models.description:
Customer questions about products listed for sale.

Stores inquiries from customers seeking additional product information before making a purchase decision. Each question is associated with a specific product and created by an authenticated customer through their active session.

Questions remain attached to the sale even if the product details change, providing historical context. Customers can ask multiple questions per product, and each question can receive one answer from the seller.

The question content includes title and body fields for structured inquiry formatting. Soft deletion is supported to maintain audit trails while allowing content moderation.

foreignFields.name: shopping_mall_product_id
foreignFields.description: The product this question pertains to. {@link shopping_mall_products.id}.

foreignFields.name: shopping_mall_customer_id
foreignFields.description: The customer who created this question. {@link shopping_mall_customers.id}.

plainFields.name: title
plainFields.description: Short title summarizing the customer's question about the product.

plainFields.name: body
plainFields.description: Detailed description of the customer's question about the product.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when this question was created.

plainFields.name: updated_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when this question was last updated.

plainFields.name: deleted_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when this question was soft-deleted (for moderation). Null if active.

models.name: shopping_mall_product_answers
models.description:
Seller responses to customer questions about products.

Stores answers provided by sellers to questions raised by customers regarding specific product listings. Each answer is linked to a single product question and the responding seller, maintaining clear ownership and auditability. Answers remain associated with the question even if the product details change, providing historical context for the interaction.

Seller responses are visible to the customer who asked the question and to other potential buyers, influencing purchasing decisions. The content includes a title for quick summary and a body for detailed information. Answers support soft deletion for moderation purposes, allowing removal while preserving audit trails.

This entity enables direct communication between sellers and customers, increasing product transparency and consumer trust.

foreignFields.name: shopping_mall_product_question_id
foreignFields.description: The product question this answer responds to. {@link shopping_mall_product_questions.id}.

foreignFields.name: shopping_mall_seller_id
foreignFields.description: The seller who provided this answer. {@link shopping_mall_sellers.id}.

plainFields.name: title
plainFields.description: Brief summary of the answer, used for quick readability and search indexing.

plainFields.name: body
plainFields.description: Detailed response content from the seller to the customer's product question.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the answer was originally created.

plainFields.name: updated_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the answer was last modified.

plainFields.name: deleted_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the answer was soft-deleted (for moderation purposes). If null, the answer is active.

models.name: shopping_mall_product_view_stats
models.description:
Analytics tracking product views, click-through rates, and engagement metrics.

System-generated statistics that record how users interact with products in the catalog.
Tracks the number of times a product is viewed, the rate at which users click through to product detail pages, and an overall engagement score based on interaction patterns.

Data is automatically updated by the system when products are displayed to users.
Each record represents a snapshot of engagement metrics for a specific product at a point in time.
This data supports product discovery optimization and recommendations systems.

The table is updated frequently but never modified or deleted after creation, making it append-only for analytical purposes.

foreignFields.name: shopping_mall_product_id
foreignFields.description: Reference to the product being tracked. {@link shopping_mall_products.id}.

plainFields.name: view_count
plainFields.description: Total number of times this product has been viewed in the catalog.

plainFields.name: click_through_rate
plainFields.description: Percentage of users who clicked through from product listing to product detail page.

plainFields.name: engagement_score
plainFields.description: Composite score measuring overall user engagement with this product (0.0-1.0).

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the view statistics record was created.

plainFields.name: updated_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the view statistics record was last updated.

plainFields.name: deleted_at
plainFields.description: Soft delete timestamp for audit trail compliance.

models.name: shopping_mall_product_sales_stats
models.description:
Sales performance statistics aggregated per product to track units sold, revenue, and conversion rates.

This table provides analytical insights into product market performance. It is automatically updated by the system when orders are completed, capturing the number of units sold, total revenue generated, and conversion rate (sales over views) for each product.

Sales statistics are maintained independently from product metadata to prevent data duplication and ensure consistent reporting, even if product details change later.

The table is updated only by system processes and is not directly modifiable by users or administrators. It enables performance analytics dashboards, inventory forecasting, and marketing evaluation.

foreignFields.name: product_id
foreignFields.description: Reference to the product this sales statistic belongs to. {@link shopping_mall_products.id}.

plainFields.name: units_sold
plainFields.description: Total number of units of this product sold.

plainFields.name: total_revenue
plainFields.description: Total revenue generated from sales of this product, in USD with exactly two decimal places.

plainFields.name: conversion_rate
plainFields.description: Conversion rate as a decimal (e.g., 0.05 for 5%), calculated as units_sold divided by product views (from shopping_mall_product_view_stats).

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when this sales statistic record was created.

plainFields.name: updated_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when this sales statistic record was last updated.

plainFields.name: deleted_at
plainFields.description: Soft delete flag. Null means active; a timestamp indicates the record was retired for audit purposes.

models.name: shopping_mall_product_snapshots
models.description:
Audit trail snapshots of product state at time of order to preserve historical product information.

Captures immutable copies of product details as they existed at the moment of purchase, ensuring accurate historical records for order reconciliation, returns, and compliance audits. This table preserves product titles, descriptions, images, categories, and other metadata even when the master product record is modified or deleted.

Each snapshot is linked to the original product via shopping_mall_products.id and represents the entire product state at snapshot creation time. The table is designed to be append-only with soft deletes to support moderation of inappropriate product representations in historical orders.

foreignFields.name: shopping_mall_product_id
foreignFields.description: Reference to the original product entity whose state was captured in this snapshot. {@link shopping_mall_products.id}.

plainFields.name: title
plainFields.description: Product title as it appeared at time of snapshot creation. Copy of shopping_mall_products.title at the moment this snapshot was taken.

plainFields.name: description
plainFields.description: Product description as it appeared at time of snapshot creation. Copy of shopping_mall_products.description at the moment this snapshot was taken.

plainFields.name: status
plainFields.description: Current product status (active/inactive) at time of snapshot. Copy of shopping_mall_products.status to maintain business state context for historical orders.

plainFields.name: primary_category_id
plainFields.description: Primary category ID reference as it existed at time of snapshot. Copy of shopping_mall_products.primary_category_id. Can be null if product had no primary category assigned.

plainFields.name: brand_id
plainFields.description: Brand ID reference as it existed at time of snapshot. Copy of shopping_mall_products.brand_id. Can be null if product had no brand assigned.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when this snapshot was created (i.e., when the product state was captured). This is not the product's creation date, but the snapshot creation time.

plainFields.name: updated_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when this snapshot was last updated. For immutable snapshots, this typically equals created_at but is included for system consistency.

plainFields.name: deleted_at
plainFields.description: Soft delete flag indicating when this snapshot was marked for deletion. Used for moderation of inappropriate product representations in historical orders. If null, the record is considered active.

models.name: shopping_mall_product_brands
models.description:
Brand entities associated with products including name and optional logo URL.

Represents manufacturers, designers, or product lines that produce or market products in the catalog. Each brand serves as a categorization and marketing anchor for associated products, helping customers identify and trust product origins.

Brands are independently managed by administrators - new brands can be created, existing ones can be updated, and brand information can be removed from the catalog entirely. While products reference brands for categorization, the brand entities themselves have independent lifecycle management.

The logo URL field is optional to accommodate brands that don't have official visual identities or when logo images are managed through separate asset systems.

plainFields.name: name
plainFields.description: Official name of the brand. Must be unique across the system to ensure consistent product categorization and branding.

plainFields.name: logo_url
plainFields.description: URL to the brand's official logo image. This is optional as some brands may not have digital logos or may use alternative branding systems.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when this brand was created in the system. Used for audit trail and chronological sorting.

plainFields.name: updated_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when this brand was last modified. Updated on any change to brand name or logo.

models.name: shopping_mall_product_variant_inventory
models.description:
Tracks real-time inventory count and state for each product variant (SKU).

This table provides granular inventory management at the SKU level, enabling accurate stock visibility, low-stock alerts, and sales forecasting. Each record corresponds to exactly one product variant and maintains its current inventory status.

Inventory state transitions (Available → Low → Out of Stock → Backordered → Discontinued) are driven by order fulfillment, returns, and restocking operations. The system automatically updates inventory counts and states without direct user intervention.

Soft deletion is supported to maintain audit trails while allowing inventory records to be logically removed when variants are discontinued permanently.

All inventory changes are tracked and verified through the product_variant system to ensure transactional integrity.

foreignFields.name: shopping_mall_product_variant_id
foreignFields.description: Reference to the product variant this inventory record belongs to. {@link shopping_mall_product_variants.id}.

plainFields.name: inventory_count
plainFields.description: Current quantity available in inventory. Must be non-negative. Updated automatically through order, return, and restocking workflows.

plainFields.name: state
plainFields.description: Current inventory state following state machine: Available, Low, Out of Stock, Backordered, Discontinued. State transitions occur automatically based on inventory count thresholds and business rules.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when this inventory record was first created.

plainFields.name: updated_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when this inventory record was last updated, including count or state changes.

plainFields.name: deleted_at
plainFields.description: Soft delete timestamp. If null, record is active. If set, record is logically deleted but preserved for audit purposes.

models.name: shopping_mall_product_variant_pricing
models.description:
Stores individual prices for each product variant (SKU), overriding base product price when specified.

This table enables variant-level pricing strategy where each unique SKU can have its own price independent of the base product's default price. The pricing data is used for product display, cart calculations, and checkout processing.

Each price entry is associated with exactly one product variant via the variant_id foreign key. In cases where no variant-specific price exists, the base product price is used as fallback. This design allows for flexible pricing tactics including promotional pricing, bulk discounts, and special edition offerings.

All prices are stored in USD with exactly two decimal places as required. The table supports soft deletion to maintain audit trails while allowing for price adjustments or removal.

foreignFields.name: shopping_mall_product_variant_id
foreignFields.description: Reference to the product variant this pricing record belongs to. {@link shopping_mall_product_variants.id}

plainFields.name: price
plainFields.description: Price of this product variant in USD, with exactly two decimal places. Must be non-negative. This overrides the base product price when specified.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when this pricing record was created. Always populated at record creation.

plainFields.name: updated_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when this pricing record was last updated. Automatically updated whenever the price changes.

plainFields.name: deleted_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when this pricing record was soft-deleted. Null if the record is still active. Used for audit trail and potential recovery.

models.name: shopping_mall_variant_attributes
models.description:
Stores definable attribute types for product variants (size, color, material, etc.) with validation rules and sortable order.

This table defines the taxonomy of variant attributes that can be applied to products across the catalog. Each row represents a distinct attribute type (e.g., 'Color', 'Size', 'Material') with associated characteristics that govern how values can be selected and validated.

Attribute types serve as templates for variant creation - they determine what kind of options can be assigned to product variants. For example, a 'Color' attribute type might require users to select from a predefined set of values, while a 'Memory Capacity' attribute type might accept numeric input with validation constraints.

The order_number field controls the display sequence of attribute types on product detail pages and during variant selection workflows.

The validator field contains JSON-formatted rules that specify constraints for attribute values (minimum/maximum values, allowed patterns, required formats), enabling dynamic UI validation for variant selection.

This table is managed exclusively by administrators and contains system-wide reference data that is referenced by all product variants in the system.

plainFields.name: name
plainFields.description: Unique display name for the attribute type (e.g., "Color", "Size", "Material"). Must be human-readable and consistent across the system.

plainFields.name: description
plainFields.description: Detailed explanation of the attribute type's purpose, usage, and business context. May describe expected value patterns or system-wide conventions.

plainFields.name: type
plainFields.description: Data type category for values of this attribute (e.g., "select", "text", "number", "boolean"). Determines UI input type and validation logic.

plainFields.name: validator
plainFields.description: JSON-formatted validation rules for attribute values. May include minimum/maximum values, allowed patterns, required formats, or allowed value sets depending on type.

plainFields.name: order_number
plainFields.description: Integer sequence number that determines the display order of attribute types on product pages and variant selection interfaces. Lower numbers appear first.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when this attribute type was created in the system.

plainFields.name: updated_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when this attribute type was last modified.

models.name: shopping_mall_variant_attribute_values
models.description:
Individual valid values for each product variant attribute type, ensuring consistency and preventing duplicates across products.

Each record represents a single possible value for a variant attribute (e.g., 'Red' for color, 'Large' for size, 'Cotton' for material). Values are strictly controlled by their parent attribute type to maintain data integrity across the product catalog. This table serves as the authoritative reference for available attribute values,
ensuring that when customers filter products or select variant combinations, they only see valid, pre-approved options.

Values are managed through the variant_attributes system and are not directly created by end users. This prevents inconsistent or invalid attribute values from polluting the product catalog.

foreignFields.name: shopping_mall_variant_attribute_id
foreignFields.description: The variant attribute this value belongs to. {@link shopping_mall_variant_attributes.id}.

plainFields.name: value
plainFields.description: The actual value of this attribute option (e.g., 'Red', 'Large', 'Cotton'). Must be unique within its attribute type and contain only alphanumeric characters, spaces, hyphens, and underscores.

plainFields.name: display_order
plainFields.description: Determines the sort order in which this attribute value appears in user interfaces (e.g., product filters, variant selectors). Lower numbers appear first.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when this attribute value was created in the system.

plainFields.name: updated_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when this attribute value was last modified.

plainFields.name: deleted_at
plainFields.description: Soft-delete timestamp marking when this attribute value was deactivated. Null means active. Used for audit trail and potential reactivation.

models.name: shopping_mall_product_variants
models.description:
Represents each unique product variant as an independent entity with its own SKU, pricing, and inventory state.

This table stores the core variant identity without storing attribute relationships directly. Each variant represents a complete product configuration that customers can select and purchase. Attributes are managed separately via variant_attribute_combinations, enabling support for multiple attribute selections (e.g., Size: Large AND Color: Blue AND Material: Cotton) that are essential for modern e-commerce catalogs.

Variant combinations are formed dynamically through references to variant_attribute_combinations, which maintain the many-to-many relationship between product variants and their attribute values. This separation follows 3NF normalization by decoupling variant definition from attribute selection.

The variant is a primary entity requiring independent API access: customers select variants directly, add them to cart, and checkout with individual variant selections. Each variant must be uniquely identifiable, queryable outside context of parent product, and support individual inventory and pricing management.

foreignFields.name: product_id
foreignFields.description: Product that this variant belongs to. {@link shopping_mall_products.id}.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when this variant combination was created in the system.

plainFields.name: updated_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when this variant combination was last modified.

plainFields.name: deleted_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when this variant combination was logically deleted (soft delete), or null if active.

models.name: shopping_mall_variant_skus
models.description:
Stores generated SKUs for product variants with encoding rules for human-readable identification.

Each SKU is a unique identifier automatically generated by the system for a specific combination of product attributes. SKU values follow consistent encoding patterns to be readable and searchable, linking directly to a single product variant.

This table is subsidiary because SKUs are system-generated and never managed independently by users - they are always accessed through their parent product_variants record. The system generates SKUs once when a variant is created and never modifies them, ensuring stability in inventory records and external systems that reference them.

The encoding rules used to construct each SKU are now normalized into a separate encoding_rules table, referenced by ID to avoid duplication and ensure consistent encoding logic across all SKUs.

foreignFields.name: shopping_mall_product_variant_id
foreignFields.description: References the product variant this SKU is generated for. {@link shopping_mall_product_variants.id}.

plainFields.name: sku
plainFields.description: The unique stock keeping unit (SKU) generated for this product variant, formatted according to the referenced encoding rule. This field must be globally unique across all product variants.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when this SKU was generated and registered in the system. Immutable after creation.

plainFields.name: updated_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp of the last update to this record. Used for audit purposes and cache invalidation, though SKU content never changes after creation.

models.name: shopping_mall_variant_inventory
models.description:
Tracks real-time inventory count per variant SKU with state machines for available, low stock, out of stock, and backordered conditions.

Maintains current stock levels for each product variant (SKU) with status indicators for inventory management workflows. The inventory state is updated automatically when orders are placed, cancelled, or returned, and when stock adjustments are made by administrators.

Each record is uniquely tied to a product variant and tracks the current quantity available for sale along with its status. This table supports the real-time display of inventory status on product pages through the variant_availability table and the automated triggering of low-stock alerts to inventory managers.

Inventory changes are audited in shopping_mall_variant_audit_logs, so this table stores only the current state as a performance optimization.

foreignFields.name: shopping_mall_product_variants_id
foreignFields.description: References the product variant this inventory record belongs to. {@link shopping_mall_product_variants.id}.

plainFields.name: quantity
plainFields.description: Current stock quantity for this variant. Must be a non-negative integer reflecting available items. Negative values indicate backordered items beyond on-hand inventory.

plainFields.name: status
plainFields.description: Current inventory state with controlled values: 'available' (in stock), 'low' (below reorder threshold), 'out_of_stock' (zero quantity), 'backordered' (negative quantity meaning customer orders exceed on-hand inventory).

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when this inventory record was initially created. Records the moment inventory tracking was activated for this variant.

plainFields.name: updated_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when this inventory record was last updated. Updated automatically whenever quantity or status changes due to sales, returns, or manual adjustments.

models.name: shopping_mall_variant_pricing
models.description:
Manages variant-specific pricing independent of base product prices, including overrides, discounts, and zero-price out-of-stock flags.

Each variant can have its own price that overrides the parent product's base price. This enables dynamic pricing strategies such as seasonal discounts, promotional pricing, or out-of-stock status indication. Price changes are tracked with full audit capability through the associated audit log system.

The pricing system supports both positive prices for available variants and zero-price flags for out-of-stock variants, providing a unified pricing model that can handle all inventory states. Pricing data is updated in real-time as inventory changes or promotions are applied.

foreignFields.name: shopping_mall_product_variant_id
foreignFields.description: Reference to the product variant this pricing applies to. {@link shopping_mall_product_variants.id}.

plainFields.name: price
plainFields.description: The current price of this product variant. Positive values indicate available price, zero value indicates out-of-stock status (is_out_of_stock = true). Prices are stored in USD with exactly two decimal places.

plainFields.name: original_price
plainFields.description: The original price before any discount was applied. Used for calculating discount percentages and showing 'was' pricing in UI. Null when no discount has been applied.

plainFields.name: discount_percentage
plainFields.description: The percentage discount applied to the original price. Used for promotional pricing calculations. Null when no discount is active. Value between 0.0 and 100.0 representing percentage.

plainFields.name: price_change_reason
plainFields.description: Human-readable reason for the price change, stored for audit trail purposes. Examples: 'Seasonal promotion', 'Inventory clearance', 'Supplier price change', 'Manual adjustment by admin'.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when this pricing record was created. Used for audit trail and chronological ordering of pricing changes.

plainFields.name: updated_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when this pricing record was last updated. Used for tracking when pricing changes occurred and for conflict resolution.

plainFields.name: deleted_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when this pricing record was logically deleted. Implements soft delete for audit trail preservation. Null indicates active record.

models.name: shopping_mall_variant_compatibility
models.description:
Defines dynamic compatibility rules between product variant attribute combinations to disable unattainable selections in the UI.

Manages business rules that determine which combinations of attribute values are permitted or prohibited when customers interact with product variations. These rules prevent customers from selecting variant combinations that are unavailable due to inventory constraints or technical incompatibilities, improving user experience and preventing invalid orders.

Each rule explicitly links a source attribute value with a target attribute value that must be excluded when the source is selected. For example: if color=red is selected, then size=large may be disabled if inventory for red+large is unavailable.

This table enables real-time UI feedback during product configuration, reducing cart abandonment and support inquiries from frustrated customers trying to select impossible combinations.

foreignFields.name: subject_attribute_value_id
foreignFields.description: The attribute value that triggers the compatibility rule. {@link shopping_mall_variant_attribute_values.id}.

foreignFields.name: object_attribute_value_id
foreignFields.description: The attribute value that is forbidden when the subject value is selected. {@link shopping_mall_variant_attribute_values.id}.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the compatibility rule was created.

plainFields.name: updated_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the compatibility rule was last updated.

plainFields.name: is_active
plainFields.description: Whether this compatibility rule is active and enforced in the UI. When false, the rule is ignored during product configuration, allowing previously blocked combinations. This enables temporary rule disablement without deletion for testing or emergency overrides.

plainFields.name: notes
plainFields.description: Optional administrative notes explaining the business rationale for this compatibility rule (e.g., "Inventory sold out for this combination", "Technical incompatibility between materials")

models.name: shopping_mall_variant_templates
models.description:
Presets of attribute combinations for commonly used products to accelerate variant creation for administrators with predefined templates.

Stores reusable combinations of variant attributes (size, color, material, etc.) as templates that administrators can apply to new products, reducing manual configuration time. Each template references a specific product variant combination and includes metadata for identification and organization.

Templates are never exposed to end customers but are used exclusively by admin users during product onboarding. They maintain no direct relationship with inventory or pricing - those are derived from the referenced product variant when the template is applied.

foreignFields.name: shopping_mall_product_variant_id
foreignFields.description: Reference to the product variant this template represents. {@link shopping_mall_product_variants.id}.

plainFields.name: name
plainFields.description: Human-readable name for this template (e.g., 'Standard T-Shirt Sizes', 'Premium Laptop Configurations').

plainFields.name: description
plainFields.description: Detailed description of what this template includes and when it should be used, for administrative clarity.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when this template was created.

plainFields.name: updated_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when this template was last modified.

plainFields.name: deleted_at
plainFields.description: Soft delete timestamp - when this template was archived. Null if active.

plainFields.name: created_by_admin_id
plainFields.description: Reference to the admin user who created this template. This references shopping_mall_admin.id from the Admin component.

models.name: shopping_mall_variant_availability
models.description:
Tracks real-time variant availability status (green/yellow/red/gray) displayed to users on product pages, updated immediately after inventory changes.

This table provides a denormalized status indicator for customer-facing display purposes. The availability status (red, yellow, green, gray) is automatically calculated from the corresponding shopping_mall_variant_inventory record, avoiding complex real-time calculations during product page rendering.

Each record corresponds exactly to one product variant's inventory state and is updated in real-time whenever inventory changes occur. The system uses this table for high-performance display of availability status on product pages without requiring joins or calculations during customer browsing.

Note: This is a subsidiary table that is entirely maintained by system processes responding to inventory changes in shopping_mall_variant_inventory.

foreignFields.name: shopping_mall_variant_inventory_id
foreignFields.description: Reference to the variant inventory record from which this availability status is calculated. {@link shopping_mall_variant_inventory.id}.

plainFields.name: status
plainFields.description: Current availability status displayed to users. Valid values: 'green' (in stock), 'yellow' (low stock), 'red' (out of stock), 'gray' (unavailable/discontinued).

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when this availability status record was first created.

plainFields.name: updated_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when this availability status was last updated in response to inventory changes.

models.name: shopping_mall_variant_audit_logs
models.description:
Immutable audit trail recording all changes to product variants, including inventory, pricing, and attribute modifications.

Captures comprehensive historical data about every modification made to variants, including who made the change, what property was changed, the previous and new values, and the type of change operation. Essential for compliance, debugging, and reconstruction of variant state over time.

Each audit record is immutable and created only when a change occurs. The table follows an append-only pattern where records are never updated or deleted. Soft delete capability is included for system-level purging while maintaining legal compliance requirements.

foreignFields.name: variant_id
foreignFields.description: Reference to the product variant that was modified. {@link shopping_mall_product_variants.id}.

foreignFields.name: user_id
foreignFields.description: Reference to the user who made the change (admin, seller, or customer). {@link shopping_mall_admin.id} if admin, {@link shopping_mall_sellers.id} if seller, {@link shopping_mall_customers.id} if customer. Nullable if system-triggered change.

plainFields.name: field_name
plainFields.description: The specific field that was modified (e.g., 'inventory_count', 'price', 'attribute_values').

plainFields.name: change_type
plainFields.description: Type of change operation performed: 'create', 'update', or 'delete'.

plainFields.name: old_value
plainFields.description: JSON string representation of the property's value before the change. Null for create operations.

plainFields.name: new_value
plainFields.description: JSON string representation of the property's value after the change. Null for delete operations.

plainFields.name: change_reason
plainFields.description: Optional human-provided reason for the change, such as 'Price adjustment for sale', 'Corrected inventory count', or 'Removed discontinued variant'.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the audit record was created, representing when the change occurred.

plainFields.name: updated_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp of the last update to this audit record (though records are immutable, this field is kept for system consistency).

plainFields.name: deleted_at
plainFields.description: Soft delete timestamp for system-level purging while maintaining compliance requirements (GDPR, CCPA, tax jurisdiction retention laws). Records are logically deleted but physically maintained to support audit and legal requirements. This field is null for active records.

models.name: shopping_mall_carts
models.description:
Stores active shopping cart sessions for authenticated customers and guest users with cart state tracking.

This is the primary container for shopping cart items, serving as the central entity for cart management operations. Each cart represents a collection of products a user intends to purchase.

For authenticated users, carts are linked to their customer_id, ensuring persistent cart state across sessions and devices. For unauthenticated guest users, carts are associated with a temporary cart_session_id that is stored in browser localStorage and linked to this cart record.

Carts remain active until explicitly cleared by the user, converted to an order, or automatically deleted after 30 days of inactivity (via deleted_at timestamp). Users can modify cart contents regardless of authentication state, but only authenticated users have cart persistence across browser sessions.

Carts do not have standalone status fields; their state is inferred from existence (active) or deletion (inactive). The shopping_mall_cart_items table contains detailed line items with quantities and pricing.

foreignFields.name: shopping_mall_customer_id
foreignFields.description: Reference to the authenticated customer who owns this cart. {@link shopping_mall_customers.id}.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the cart was first created.

plainFields.name: updated_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp of the last modification (item added/removed/quantity changed) to this cart.

plainFields.name: deleted_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when cart was deleted due to inactivity (30-day rule) or user action. Null indicates active cart.

models.name: shopping_mall_cart_items
models.description:
Individual product variants added to shopping carts with quantities and prices captured at time of addition.

Each item represents a specific product variant selected by a customer in their cart, with the exact quantity and price at the moment of addition. This captures the state of the cart at creation time, ensuring pricing accuracy even if product prices change later. Items are exclusively managed through their parent shopping_mall_carts entity and have no independent API endpoints.

When a cart is converted to an order, these items are copied to shopping_mall_order_items to preserve historical transaction data. Cart items can be removed (soft-deleted) or updated in quantity while the cart remains active, but are never edited after order conversion.

foreignFields.name: shopping_mall_cart_id
foreignFields.description: Parent cart that contains this item. {@link shopping_mall_carts.id}.

foreignFields.name: shopping_mall_product_variant_id
foreignFields.description: Product variant referenced by this cart item, specifying exact attributes and SKU. {@link shopping_mall_product_variants.id}.

plainFields.name: quantity
plainFields.description: Number of units of the product variant in the cart at the time of addition. Must be positive.

plainFields.name: price
plainFields.description: Price per unit of the product variant at the exact time it was added to the cart. Stored as decimal with 2 places for financial accuracy.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when this cart item was added to the cart. Immutable after creation.

plainFields.name: updated_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp of the last update to this cart item's quantity or modification state.

plainFields.name: deleted_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when this cart item was removed from the cart (soft delete). Null when item is still active in cart.

models.name: shopping_mall_wishlists
models.description:
Stores customer wishlist collections as independent entities from shopping carts for future consideration.

Represents curated collections of products that customers wish to purchase in the future. Each wishlist is owned by a single authenticated customer and persists independently of the shopping cart.

Wishlists enable customers to save products for later consideration without committing to purchase. Multiple wishlists can be created per customer for different purposes (e.g., gifts, future purchases, wishlists for different occasions).

Wishlist items themselves are tracked in the shopping_mall_wishlist_items table, which links to both the wishlist and the product variant.

foreignFields.name: shopping_mall_customer_id
foreignFields.description: Customer who owns this wishlist. {@link shopping_mall_customers.id}.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when this wishlist was created. Used for durability and expiration logic.

models.name: shopping_mall_wishlist_items
models.description:
Individual product variants added to customer wishlists.

Tracks which product variants customers have added to their wishlists for future consideration. Each entry represents a single product variant in a specific customer's wishlist, recording the time of addition.

Wishlist items are managed exclusively through their parent wishlist entity - customers add or remove items as part of managing their wishlist as a whole, not as individual items. These entries do not have independent lifecycle management outside the context of their parent wishlist.

foreignFields.name: shopping_mall_wishlist_id
foreignFields.description: The wishlist this item belongs to. {@link shopping_mall_wishlists.id}.

foreignFields.name: shopping_mall_product_variant_id
foreignFields.description: The product variant added to the wishlist. {@link shopping_mall_product_variants.id}.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when this variant was added to the wishlist.

models.name: shopping_mall_cart_sessions
models.description:
Tracks temporary session identifiers and timestamps for guest carts to enable persistence across sessions and 30-day expiration logic.

This subsidiary table enables guest users to maintain shopping cart data across browser sessions without authentication. Each guest cart session is linked to a specific shopping_mall_cart through a unique 1:1 relationship. The session_id serves as the persistent identifier stored in browser localStorage for guest users.

The table tracks creation and last accessed timestamps to implement automatic expiration of inactive guest carts after 30 days. When a guest user registers as a customer, their guest cart session is linked to their new customer account, maintaining cart continuity.

foreignFields.name: shopping_mall_cart_id
foreignFields.description: Reference to the shopping_mall_carts entry that this session belongs to. {@link shopping_mall_carts.id}.

plainFields.name: session_id
plainFields.description: Temporary unique session identifier generated for guest cart persistence, stored in browser localStorage.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when this guest cart session was first created.

plainFields.name: updated_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp of the last access or update to this guest cart session, used for 30-day expiration logic.

plainFields.name: deleted_at
plainFields.description: Soft delete timestamp for expired guest cart sessions (30-day inactivity). Null means active, non-null means expired and scheduled for cleanup.

models.name: shopping_mall_orders
models.description:
Main order record containing customer, status, total, and metadata for each completed purchase transaction.

Stores the primary entity for all completed purchase transactions on the platform. Each order represents a buyer's commitment to purchase one or more products, with associated payment, shipping, and fulfillment information captured at the time of creation.

The order record serves as the central hub for the entire transaction lifecycle - connecting customers to their purchases, linking to payment records, and anchoring shipping addresses. Historical state preservation is maintained through immutable order items and address snapshots, while the order itself tracks the overall transaction status.

Soft deletion is supported to maintain audit trails while allowing for order cancellations and removals.

foreignFields.name: shopping_mall_customer_id
foreignFields.description: Customer who placed this order. {@link shopping_mall_customers.id}.

plainFields.name: status
plainFields.description: Current state of the order in its lifecycle. Valid values: pending, confirmed, shipped, delivered, cancelled, returned, refunded. Status transitions follow defined business rules with audit trail in shopping_mall_order_events.

plainFields.name: currency
plainFields.description: Currency code in ISO 4217 format (e.g., USD, EUR, JPY) used for this order.

plainFields.name: total_amount
plainFields.description: Total price of all items in this order at time of purchase, including taxes and fees but excluding shipping costs.

plainFields.name: shipping_cost
plainFields.description: Cost charged for shipping this order to the customer's address.

plainFields.name: tax_amount
plainFields.description: Total tax amount calculated and charged for this order based on jurisdiction and product types.

plainFields.name: order_number
plainFields.description: Unique human-readable order identifier generated after order confirmation. Format: ORD-YYYYMMDD-XXXXX.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when this order was initially created in the system.

plainFields.name: updated_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp of the last update to this order record

plainFields.name: deleted_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when this order was soft-deleted (cancelled permanently). May be null if order is still active.

plainFields.name: coupon_discount_code
plainFields.description: Coupon code applied to this order, if any, for discount calculation.

plainFields.name: notes
plainFields.description: Optional customer-provided notes or special instructions for this order.

plainFields.name: placed_from
plainFields.description: Device or platform from which this order was placed (e.g., 'web', 'android', 'ios').

models.name: shopping_mall_order_items
models.description:
Individual product items within an order, storing variant, quantity, price, and seller reference at time of purchase.

Captures the exact product variant details, quantity, and price as they existed at the time of order placement. This ensures historical accuracy for order fulfillment, financial reconciliation, and customer inquiries, even if product prices or inventory levels change later.

Each order item maintains a reference to its parent order, the specific product variant purchased, and the seller who fulfilled the item. The price is stored as a snapshot of the value at purchase time, not calculated dynamically from current pricing data.

This table supports business requirements for detailed order history analysis, refund processing, and accurate financial reporting based on actual transaction details.

foreignFields.name: shopping_mall_order_id
foreignFields.description: Parent order that contains this item. {@link shopping_mall_orders.id}.

foreignFields.name: shopping_mall_product_variant_id
foreignFields.description: Product variant that was purchased. {@link shopping_mall_product_variants.id}.

foreignFields.name: shopping_mall_seller_id
foreignFields.description: Seller who provided this product variant. {@link shopping_mall_sellers.id}.

plainFields.name: quantity
plainFields.description: Number of units of the product variant purchased. Must be positive integer.
