foreignFields.description: The review being flagged. {@link shopping_mall_reviews.id}.

foreignFields.name: shopping_mall_customer_id
foreignFields.description: The customer who submitted the flag. {@link shopping_mall_customers.id}.

plainFields.name: reason
plainFields.description: Standardized reason code for the flag. Valid values: 'spam', 'inappropriate_content', 'false_information', 'harassment', 'other'. Must be a concise label identifying the nature of the reported issue.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the flag was created. Always set to current system time when flag is submitted. Used for moderation prioritization and audit trails.

models.name: shopping_mall_review_moderation_logs
models.description:
Immutably logs all moderator decisions on flagged reviews with audit trail.

Records the actions taken by administrators when reviewing flagged content, including approval, rejection, or other moderation decisions. Each entry represents a discrete, immutable action taken in response to a review flag.

The log captures the moderator identity, the specific review that was moderated, the action taken, and the justification for the decision. These records serve as permanent audit trails for content moderation compliance and are never modified or deleted after creation.

Relevant for ensuring platform governance, legal compliance, and transparency in content moderation workflows.

foreignFields.name: shopping_mall_review_id
foreignFields.description: The review that was subject to this moderation action. {@link shopping_mall_reviews.id}.

foreignFields.name: shopping_mall_admin_id
foreignFields.description: The administrator who performed this moderation action. {@link shopping_mall_admins.id}.

plainFields.name: action
plainFields.description: The moderation action taken. Valid values: 'approve', 'reject', 'hide', 'remove'.

plainFields.name: justification
plainFields.description: The detailed reason provided by the moderator for their decision. Typically 50-2000 characters, documenting policy violation rationale or approval justification.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: The exact timestamp when this moderation action was performed. This is never modified after creation as this is an immutable audit log.

models.name: shopping_mall_review_images
models.description:
Stores image files uploaded with product reviews for visual context.

Each image is associated with exactly one product review and serves as supplementary visual evidence supporting the text review content. Images are managed exclusively through their parent review and do not have independent existence or management capabilities in the system.

Images are stored as secure URLs pointing to content delivery networks (CDN) and are never stored directly in the database. The table maintains audit trail through creation and update timestamps.

When a review is deleted, all associated images are automatically removed through database cascade deletion rules.

foreignFields.name: shopping_mall_review_id
foreignFields.description: The review this image belongs to. {@link shopping_mall_reviews.id}.

plainFields.name: image_url
plainFields.description: Secure URL pointing to the image asset stored on CDN. This is not a database-stored file but a reference to external storage.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when this image was uploaded and associated with the review.

plainFields.name: updated_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when this image record was last modified (typically when image metadata changes).

models.name: shopping_mall_review_replies
models.description:
Seller responses to customer reviews, maintaining separate conversation threads.

Allows sellers to provide direct replies to customer reviews, enhancing customer engagement and service quality. Each reply is associated with a specific review and written by an authenticated seller through their session.

Replies are managed entirely through the parent review interface - sellers cannot create replies independently, and customers do not have direct access to create or modify replies. Moderation of replies follows the same flags and processes as reviews.

Replies are soft-deletable to allow removal of inappropriate content while preserving audit history. The system maintains the reply's original content even after deletion for compliance purposes.

foreignFields.name: shopping_mall_review_id
foreignFields.description: Reference to the customer review being responded to. {@link shopping_mall_reviews.id}.

foreignFields.name: shopping_mall_seller_id
foreignFields.description: Reference to the seller who authored this reply. {@link shopping_mall_sellers.id}.

plainFields.name: title
plainFields.description: Optional short title for the seller's response. Typically used for summary or attention-grabbing phrases.

plainFields.name: body
plainFields.description: Core message content of the seller's reply. Limited to 2000 characters to ensure concise, professional responses.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the seller's reply was created.

plainFields.name: updated_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the seller's reply was last modified. Used for auditing and displaying "last updated" information.

plainFields.name: deleted_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when this reply was soft-deleted, typically by moderation. NULL means reply is active and visible.

models.name: shopping_mall_seller_verification_documents
models.description:
Stores business documentation (tax ID, license) submitted during seller verification process.

This table captures official documentation that sellers submit to verify their business identity and compliance with platform regulations. Each document is linked to a specific seller and represents a single file or record (such as tax identification certificate, business license, or commercial registration). The document is stored as a secure URL reference, with metadata tracking its type and approval status.

Documents remain associated with the seller even if their verification status changes, providing a complete audit trail. The platform requires sellers to submit at least one document to complete onboarding, and documents may be requested for re-verification periodically.

Multiple document types may be submitted under the same seller, with each document having independent status tracking for approval, rejection, or pending review.

This table follows a subsidiary stance as documents are managed through seller onboarding flows rather than independently by users.

foreignFields.name: shopping_mall_seller_id
foreignFields.description: Seller's {@link shopping_mall_sellers.id} who submitted this documentation.

plainFields.name: document_type
plainFields.description: Type of business document submitted (e.g., 'tax_id', 'business_license', 'commercial_registration'). Must be one of the predefined values in the application.

plainFields.name: document_url
plainFields.description: Secure URL pointing to the stored document file in cloud storage. Generated by the system upon upload and must be publicly accessible with a signed token.

plainFields.name: status
plainFields.description: Current verification status of the document: 'pending_review', 'approved', 'rejected', or 'expiring_soon'. Status evolves through verification workflow.

plainFields.name: uploaded_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the document was uploaded by the seller. Used for tracking submission timelines.

plainFields.name: reviewed_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the document was reviewed by platform staff. Null until first review occurs.

plainFields.name: review_notes
plainFields.description: Internal notes from platform reviewer explaining approval/rejection decision. May include requests for additional documentation.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Record creation timestamp in system. Always set automatically by database.

plainFields.name: updated_at
plainFields.description: Last update timestamp in system. Automatically updated on any changes to the document record.

plainFields.name: deleted_at
plainFields.description: Soft delete timestamp for documentation that has been revoked or replaced. Allows audit trail while logically removing from active view.

models.name: shopping_mall_seller_bank_accounts
models.description:
Bank account details for seller payouts, linked to verified sellers.

Stores financial information required for processing seller payouts and settlements. Each record represents a single bank account associated with a verified seller. This table enables automated payment routing to sellers' financial institutions while ensuring compliance with financial regulations and audit requirements.

Bank accounts are managed as part of the seller onboarding and verification process. Sellers may have multiple bank accounts for different purposes (e.g., primary, secondary) but must complete verification to enable payout functionality. The account status controls whether payouts can be processed to this account.

foreignFields.name: shopping_mall_seller_id
foreignFields.description: Reference to the verified seller who owns this bank account. {@link shopping_mall_sellers.id}.

plainFields.name: account_holder_name
plainFields.description: Legal name of the account holder as registered with the bank. Must match official identification documents submitted during seller verification.

plainFields.name: bank_name
plainFields.description: Official name of the financial institution where the account is held. Includes bank and branch information if needed.

plainFields.name: account_number
plainFields.description: Bank account number. This is the primary account identifier used for transfers and payments.

plainFields.name: routing_number
plainFields.description: Bank routing number (ABA number in US). Used to route payments to the correct financial institution.

plainFields.name: account_status
plainFields.description: Current status of the bank account. Valid values: 'active', 'inactive', 'verified', 'pending_verification', 'rejected'. Controls whether payouts can be processed to this account.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when this bank account record was created in the system.

plainFields.name: updated_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when this bank account record was last updated.

plainFields.name: deleted_at
plainFields.description: Optional timestamp for soft deletion. Indicates when this bank account was deactivated or removed from active use.

models.name: shopping_mall_seller_dashboard_settings
models.description:
Seller-specific configuration preferences for dashboard interface and notifications.

Stores customizable dashboard settings for sellers to personalize their administrative interface experience. This includes notification preferences, visual theme selection, default layout configuration, timezone, and language settings. The settings are associated with and managed through the seller's primary account in the Actors component.

The status field enables administrators to disable a seller's dashboard access without deleting the profile, supporting compliance workflows for account suspension.

foreignFields.name: shopping_mall_seller_id
foreignFields.description: Seller account this dashboard setting belongs to. {@link shopping_mall_sellers.id}.

plainFields.name: notification_preferences
plainFields.description: JSON string storing notification preferences including email, in-app, and SMS settings.

plainFields.name: theme
plainFields.description: Preferred visual theme for dashboard UI. Values: 'light', 'dark', 'system'.

plainFields.name: layout
plainFields.description: Dashboard layout configuration in JSON format specifying widget positions.

plainFields.name: default_view
plainFields.description: Default view to load when seller logs in. Values: 'dashboard', 'orders', 'products', 'analytics'.

plainFields.name: timezone
plainFields.description: Timezone setting for displaying timestamps in dashboard. Must be valid IANA timezone identifier (e.g., 'Asia/Seoul').

plainFields.name: language
plainFields.description: Preferred language for UI text. ISO 639-1 language code (e.g., 'en', 'ko').

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Datetime when the dashboard settings were created. Always populated.

plainFields.name: updated_at
plainFields.description: Datetime when the dashboard settings were last updated. Always populated.

plainFields.name: deleted_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp marking when settings were logically deleted. Null if active.

plainFields.name: status
plainFields.description: Current status of dashboard access. Values: 'active', 'disabled', 'suspended'. Required for compliance with seller management requirements.

models.name: shopping_mall_seller_onboarding_completion
models.description:
Tracks the completion status of seller onboarding steps during registration.

Records the onboarding status of sellers through a normalized state value rather than nullable flags. This table is updated as sellers progress through the onboarding workflow, allowing the system to enforce restrictions until complete.

The onboarding status is now tracked through a non-nullable 'status' field with fixed values: 'in_progress', 'completed', or 'failed'. A dedicated completion timestamp records when the process was successfully finished.

Soft deletion is supported to maintain audit trails while allowing for account reactivation or data correction.

This table is managed exclusively through seller registration flows and does not require independent API operations.

foreignFields.name: shopping_mall_seller_id
foreignFields.description: The seller account this onboarding status belongs to. {@link shopping_mall_sellers.id}.

plainFields.name: status
plainFields.description: Current state of seller onboarding. Valid values: 'in_progress' (initial state), 'completed' (verified and setup complete), 'failed' (verification failed and needs re-submission).

plainFields.name: completed_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the seller successfully completed all onboarding steps. Only populated when status is 'completed'.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: When the onboarding record was initially created.

plainFields.name: updated_at
plainFields.description: When the onboarding status was last updated.

plainFields.name: deleted_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when this onboarding record was soft-deleted. Null indicates active record.

models.name: shopping_mall_seller_performance_metrics
models.description:
Aggregated performance metrics for sellers, calculated by the platform based on order fulfillment, customer feedback, and response times.

Tracks key performance indicators used to evaluate seller quality, eligibility for platform promotions, and potential enforcement actions. These metrics are automatically updated by the system based on seller activities and customer interactions, and are not directly editable by sellers themselves.

The metrics include average rating, average response time to customer inquiries, order fulfillment rate, dispute count, and total feedback received. This table enables platform-wide seller ranking, automated promotion eligibility checks, and identification of underperforming sellers for assistance or intervention.

foreignFields.name: shopping_mall_seller_id
foreignFields.description: The seller this performance data belongs to. {@link shopping_mall_sellers.id}.

plainFields.name: rating_avg
plainFields.description: Average customer rating for this seller, calculated from all product reviews. Value ranges from 1.0 to 5.0 with one decimal precision.

plainFields.name: response_time_avg
plainFields.description: Average response time in hours for seller responses to customer questions. Calculated from time of question creation to answer posting. Values are in whole hours.

plainFields.name: fulfillment_rate
plainFields.description: Percentage of orders shipped within promised timeframe, calculated as (orders shipped on time / total orders) * 100. Values range from 0.0 to 100.0.

plainFields.name: disputes_count
plainFields.description: Total number of open and resolved disputes initiated by customers against this seller over the past 90 days.

plainFields.name: feedback_count
plainFields.description: Total number of customer feedback events (ratings, reviews, questions) received from customers in the past 90 days.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when this performance metrics record was first created in the system.

plainFields.name: updated_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when this performance metrics record was last updated by the system's calculation job.

models.name: shopping_mall_seller_communication_logs
models.description:
Logs all internal messages between sellers and platform support for dispute resolution.

Captures structured communication history that facilitates customer service, policy enforcement, and conflict resolution between sellers and platform administrators. Each log entry represents one message in a thread, with metadata about sender, recipient, and context.

Messages are managed through seller profiles and admin dashboards as part of dispute resolution workflows. The table serves as an audit trail for platform moderation actions and provides evidence for compliance reviews.

foreignFields.name: shopping_mall_seller_id
foreignFields.description: Seller who initiated or received the message. {@link shopping_mall_sellers.id}.

plainFields.name: subject
plainFields.description: Short subject or title of the communication. May be empty for simple messages.

plainFields.name: body
plainFields.description: Full text content of the communication message. Contains the complete message body from sender.

plainFields.name: sender_type
plainFields.description: Role of the sender: 'seller' or 'admin'. Indicates whether the message originated from the seller or platform support team.

plainFields.name: recipient_type
plainFields.description: Role of the recipient: 'seller' or 'admin'. Indicates whether the message is addressed to the seller or platform support team.

plainFields.name: is_read
plainFields.description: Flag indicating whether the recipient has read this message. Used to track response status and manage communication flow.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the communication was created and logged in the system.

plainFields.name: updated_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the communication was last modified (e.g., marked as read).

plainFields.name: deleted_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the communication was marked for deletion (soft delete). Null if not deleted.

models.name: shopping_mall_seller_compliance_history
models.description:
Audit trail of compliance violations, warnings, and enforcement actions taken against sellers.

Records all formal actions taken against sellers for policy violations including warnings, suspensions, fines, and terminations. This table serves as the permanent audit trail for compliance monitoring and regulatory reporting.

Each entry represents a single enforcement action taken by platform administrators, automated systems, or other authorized actors. Violations are captured at time of action with immutable details including violation type, description, severity level, and action taken. The record is linked to the specific seller and the actor (admin, system, etc.) who executed the action.

This table supports compliance reviews, regulatory audits, and historical analysis of seller conduct patterns. No direct user interaction - records are created exclusively by system when actors issue compliance actions.

foreignFields.name: shopping_mall_seller_id
foreignFields.description: Seller who received the compliance action. {@link shopping_mall_sellers.id}.

plainFields.name: actor_type
plainFields.description: Type of actor initiating the compliance action: 'admin', 'system', or other authorized actor type.

plainFields.name: actor_id
plainFields.description: Identifier of the actor who performed the compliance action. Links to the corresponding actor type table.

plainFields.name: violation_type
plainFields.description: Type of violation (e.g., 'false advertising', 'counterfeit goods', 'shipping delays', 'review manipulation', 'policy violation').

plainFields.name: description
plainFields.description: Detailed description of the violation including evidence, timestamps, and context where applicable.

plainFields.name: severity
plainFields.description: Severity level of the violation: 'low', 'medium', 'high', 'critical'.

plainFields.name: action_taken
plainFields.description: Action taken as result of violation: 'warning', 'fine', 'suspension', 'termination', 'demotion', 'notification'.

plainFields.name: evidence_reference
plainFields.description: Reference ID or link to supporting evidence (e.g., ticket number, report ID, image ID).

plainFields.name: metadata
plainFields.description: JSON object containing additional context not covered by standard fields (e.g., specific policy clause violated, affected listings, duration of suspension).

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the compliance action was recorded.

plainFields.name: updated_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the record was last updated (for audit trail consistency).

plainFields.name: deleted_at
plainFields.description: Soft delete timestamp for audit trail compliance. If null, record is active.

models.name: shopping_mall_seller_subscription_tiers
models.description:
Tracks active subscription tiers for sellers, including premium features and fees.

Records the subscription plan a seller has activated, including associated costs, features, and duration. Each seller can have only one active subscription tier at a time, managed through their seller account profile. This table supports recurring billing and premium feature access for seller accounts.

Subscription tiers represent different levels of service that sellers can choose from (e.g., 'Basic', 'Standard', 'Premium') and are updated when sellers upgrade, downgrade, or cancel their subscription. The system uses this information to determine seller benefits, transaction fees, and visibility privileges within the marketplace.

foreignFields.name: shopping_mall_seller_id
foreignFields.description: The seller who owns this subscription tier. {@link shopping_mall_sellers.id}.

plainFields.name: tier_name
plainFields.description: Name of the subscription tier (e.g., 'Basic', 'Standard', 'Premium'). Must be a standardized, canonical value from a predefined set of tier names.

plainFields.name: description
plainFields.description: Detailed description of the features and benefits included in this subscription tier.

plainFields.name: price
plainFields.description: Monthly subscription fee in USD for this tier. Always stored as a positive decimal number with two decimal places.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when this subscription tier was first created and activated for the seller.

plainFields.name: updated_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp of the last update to this subscription tier (e.g., when upgraded, downgraded, or renewed).

plainFields.name: deleted_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp of when this subscription tier was deactivated or canceled. Null indicates active subscription.

models.name: shopping_mall_admin
models.description:
Admin user accounts with credentials, permissions, and authentication metadata.

Represents platform administrators with full system control and moderation privileges across the entire shopping_mall ecosystem. This entity serves as the authoritative source for administrative access, enabling secure management of users, products, orders, configurations, and system policies.

Each admin account is linked to a dedicated session table for authentication tracking and security auditing. Admin accounts have the highest privilege level and can perform any operation within the system, including modifying other admins' permissions. Access is strictly controlled through authentication and authorization mechanisms.

plainFields.name: email
plainFields.description: Admin email address used for authentication and communication. Must be unique across all admin accounts.

plainFields.name: password_hash
plainFields.description: Cryptographic hash of the admin's password for secure authentication. Never stored in plain text.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the admin account was created. Used for auditing and compliance tracking.

plainFields.name: updated_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the admin account was last updated. Used for tracking changes to admin metadata.

plainFields.name: deleted_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the admin account was logically deleted. Supports soft deletion for audit trails while maintaining referential integrity.

models.name: shopping_mall_audit_logs
models.description:
Immutable audit logs recording all administrative actions, including actor, timestamp, IP, and change details.

Stores a comprehensive and tamper-proof history of all operations performed by platform administrators. Each log entry captures what action was taken, which admin performed it, what record was affected, and from which IP address the action originated. This table serves as the primary audit trail for compliance, security investigations, and operational transparency.

Logs are immutable - once created, they are never modified or deleted (though they may be logically soft-deleted to maintain audit integrity). The description field captures rich context about the action performed, enabling forensic analysis and regulatory reporting.

foreignFields.name: admin_id
foreignFields.description: The admin user who performed the audited action. {@link shopping_mall_admin.id}.

plainFields.name: action_type
plainFields.description: Type of administrative action performed. Standardized values include: create, update, delete, activate, deactivate, modify, approve, reject, reset, export, configure, alert. Used for categorization and automated alerting.

plainFields.name: description
plainFields.description: Detailed textual description of the administrative action and its context. May include specific values changed, affected record identifiers, and reason for the action. Used for forensic analysis and compliance reporting.

plainFields.name: affected_table_name
plainFields.description: Name of the database table that was affected by this administrative action (e.g., 'shopping_mall_users', 'shopping_mall_products', 'shopping_mall_platform_configurations'). Enables quick identification of impacted entities.

plainFields.name: affected_record_id
plainFields.description: Primary key identifier of the specific record that was affected by this administrative action, if applicable. Null when the action affects multiple records or system-wide settings.

plainFields.name: ip_address
plainFields.description: IP address from which the administrative action was initiated. Essential for security monitoring, geolocation analysis, and detecting unauthorized access patterns.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when this audit log entry was created. Always populated at the moment the action occurred.

plainFields.name: deleted_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when this audit log entry was logically soft-deleted. Used to maintain audit trail integrity while allowing compliance with data retention policies and regulatory requirements.

models.name: shopping_mall_platform_configurations
models.description:
Platform-wide configuration settings including branding, payment, shipping, and security parameters.

Stores core operational parameters that control system-wide behavior across all components including customer experience, payment processing, shipping integrations, and administrative security policies. This entity represents the master configuration for the entire e-commerce platform and is managed exclusively through the admin dashboard by platform administrators.

Configuration values override default system behaviors and are loaded at runtime by all services. Changes to this configuration are tracked in the shopping_mall_config_history table to maintain audit trails and support rollback capabilities. This table does not store historical versions but rather the current active configuration state.

plainFields.name: branding_title
plainFields.description: Primary brand name displayed throughout the platform. Used in headers, emails, and UI elements. Must reflect the official company brand identity.

plainFields.name: branding_logo_url
plainFields.description: HTTP/HTTPS URL pointing to the platform's primary logo image. Used in UI headers and email templates. Must be a publicly accessible, properly formatted URI.

plainFields.name: payment_gateway_primary
plainFields.description: Primary payment gateway identifier (e.g., 'stripe', 'paypal', 'razorpay'). Determines the default payment processing provider for all transactions when not overridden per region or method.

plainFields.name: payment_gateway_secondary
plainFields.description: Secondary payment gateway identifier for failover purposes. Used when primary gateway is unavailable. Must be a valid identifier from supported payment providers.

plainFields.name: shipping_carrier_primary
plainFields.description: Primary shipping carrier identifier (e.g., 'fedex', 'ups', 'dhl', 'usps'). Used for default shipping method selection and rate calculation when no specific carrier is chosen by the customer.

plainFields.name: shipping_carrier_secondary
plainFields.description: Secondary shipping carrier identifier for fallback purposes. Used when the primary carrier is unavailable or has service disruptions.

plainFields.name: currency_code
plainFields.description: Base currency code (ISO 4217) used for all financial transactions on the platform. Common values: USD, EUR, GBP, JPY. All monetary values are stored in this currency unless overridden by multi-currency support.

plainFields.name: tax_calculation_strategy
plainFields.description: Method for calculating sales tax: 'origin', 'destination', 'business_address'. Determines whether tax is calculated based on seller location, customer location, or registered business location.

plainFields.name: email_sender_domain
plainFields.description: Domain used as the sender domain for all platform emails (e.g., 'notifications.shoppingmallsystem.com'). Must be DNS-verified and configured with correct SPF/DKIM records for deliverability.

plainFields.name: default_locale
plainFields.description: Default language and region locale for users who haven't set preferences. Format: ISO 639-1 language code plus ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 country code (e.g., 'en-US', 'ja-JP').

plainFields.name: max_session_duration_minutes
plainFields.description: Maximum session duration in minutes for all user types (customers, sellers, admins) before requiring re-authentication. Enforces security policy for session management.

plainFields.name: session_inactivity_timeout_minutes
plainFields.description: Inactivity timeout period in minutes after which user sessions are automatically expired. Applies to all actor types regardless of session type.

plainFields.name: password_complexity_min_length
plainFields.description: Minimum character length required for passwords across all user types. Enforces basic password strength standards.

plainFields.name: password_complexity_require_uppercase
plainFields.description: Indicates whether passwords must contain at least one uppercase letter. Part of password complexity rules enforced during registration and password changes.

plainFields.name: password_complexity_require_lowercase
plainFields.description: Indicates whether passwords must contain at least one lowercase letter. Part of password complexity rules enforced during registration and password changes.

plainFields.name: password_complexity_require_numbers
plainFields.description: Indicates whether passwords must contain at least one numeric digit. Part of password complexity rules enforced during registration and password changes.

plainFields.name: password_complexity_require_symbols
plainFields.description: Indicates whether passwords must contain at least one special symbol (e.g., !@#$%^&*). Part of password complexity rules enforced during registration and password changes.

plainFields.name: login_failed_attempts_threshold
plainFields.description: Maximum number of failed login attempts allowed before account locking mechanism activates. Prevents brute force attacks on user credentials.

plainFields.name: login_lockout_duration_minutes
plainFields.description: Duration in minutes that an account remains locked after exceeding the failed login attempts threshold. Provides temporary protection against automated attacks.

plainFields.name: ip_blocking_enabled
plainFields.description: Enables or disables automated IP blocking system that detects and blocks malicious or suspicious IP addresses based on behavior patterns.

plainFields.name: fraud_detection_enabled
plainFields.description: Enables or disables real-time fraud detection system that analyzes transaction patterns, shipping addresses, and device fingerprints for potential fraudulent activity.

plainFields.name: email_verification_required
plainFields.description: Requires all new customers and sellers to verify their email address before their accounts can be fully activated and utilized for transactions.

plainFields.name: product_search_enabled
plainFields.description: Enables or disables the product search functionality across all storefronts. When disabled, product discovery is limited to category browsing.

plainFields.name: review_submissions_enabled
plainFields.description: Controls whether customers can submit product reviews. When disabled, all review submission features are hidden and disabled throughout the platform.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when this configuration record was created. Immutable record of when the current configuration set became active.

plainFields.name: updated_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when this configuration record was last modified. Updated automatically whenever any configuration field changes.

plainFields.name: deleted_at
plainFields.description: Optional soft delete timestamp for audit purposes. When non-null, indicates this configuration set has been retired and is no longer active. Never deleted permanently.

models.name: shopping_mall_email_templates
models.description:
Email templates for administrative, customer, and seller notifications with customizable content and trigger configurations.

Stores predefined email message templates used by the platform to send automated notifications to users. These templates include subject lines and body content that can be dynamically populated with user-specific data. Admins can create, edit, and enable/disable templates for various business scenarios such as order confirmations, password resets, policy updates, and system alerts.

Templates are version-controlled through the platform's configuration history system. The template content is separate from actual sent email records to allow for template modifications without affecting historical communications. Each template has a unique name used to reference it programmatically.

plainFields.name: name
plainFields.description: Unique identifier for the template used in code and configuration. Must be machine-readable and unique across all templates.

plainFields.name: subject
plainFields.description: The email subject line that will be used. May contain placeholders for dynamic content such as {{user_name}} or {{order_id}}.

plainFields.name: body
plainFields.description: The complete HTML content of the email template. Supports dynamic placeholders that will be replaced with actual values when the email is sent.

plainFields.name: trigger
plainFields.description: The business event that triggers this template to be sent. Examples: 'order_confirmation', 'password_reset', 'new_product_alert', 'policy_update'.

plainFields.name: context
plainFields.description: The intended recipient category for this template. Values: 'admin', 'customer', 'seller'. Determines which users should receive this notification.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when this email template was created in the system.

plainFields.name: updated_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when this email template was last modified.

plainFields.name: deleted_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp marking when this template was logically deleted. Null indicates the template is active.

models.name: shopping_mall_security_policies
models.description:
Platform-wide security policies governing admin login and session behavior.

Defines mandatory rules for password complexity, authentication session duration, and IP access restrictions for all administrators. These policies are enforced system-wide and managed independently by senior administrators.

The policy record is versioned to maintain audit history of security changes. When updated, the new policy replaces the previous active version, while old versions are preserved for compliance audits. The policy can be disabled by setting deleted_at, but never deleted permanently to preserve audit trail.

This table does not store admin credentials - those reside in shopping_mall_admin. This table defines the security rules those credentials must meet and how sessions behave.

plainFields.name: password_complexity
plainFields.description:
Required password complexity pattern using regex (e.g., '^(?=.*[a-z])(?=.*[A-Z])(?=.*\d)(?=.*[!@#$%^&*]).{12,}
'). Enforces mandatory character types and minimum length.

plainFields.name: min_password_length
plainFields.description: Minimum number of characters required in admin passwords. Must be at least 12 according to enterprise security standards.

plainFields.name: max_password_age
plainFields.description: Maximum age in days before admin passwords expire and must be changed. Enforces regular credential rotation for security.

plainFields.name: session_timeout_minutes
plainFields.description: Duration in minutes of inactivity after which admin sessions will expire and require re-authentication. Applies to all admin sessions.

plainFields.name: ip_allow_list
plainFields.description: Comma-separated list of allowed IP addresses or CIDR ranges (e.g., '192.168.1.0/24, 203.0.113.10'). Admins can only log in from these IPs if list is defined.

plainFields.name: ip_deny_list
plainFields.description: Comma-separated list of denied IP addresses or CIDR ranges (e.g., '192.0.2.1, 203.0.113.0/24'). Admins are blocked from logging in from these IPs.

plainFields.name: version
plainFields.description: Sequential version number for policy changes. Higher numbers indicate newer policies. Used to identify the currently active security policy.

plainFields.name: is_active
plainFields.description: Flag indicating whether this policy version is currently active and enforced. Only one policy can be active at a time.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when this security policy version was created and initialized.

plainFields.name: updated_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when this security policy version was last modified.

plainFields.name: deleted_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when this policy version was logically deleted (soft delete). Used to maintain audit history without permanent removal.

models.name: shopping_mall_compliance_records
models.description:
Immutable audit trail of regulatory compliance documentation for GDPR, CCPA, and tax jurisdiction requirements.

Records all compliance-related documentation timestamps, jurisdiction codes, and administrative verification details. Each record represents a point-in-time snapshot of regulatory compliance status at the moment an admin or system process confirms adherence to specific legal frameworks.

This table is append-only and never modified after creation. Deleted records maintain their data with deleted_at timestamps to ensure complete auditability for regulators. The table serves as legal evidence of compliance and must preserve historical accuracy regardless of subsequent system changes.

foreignFields.name: admin_id
foreignFields.description: The administrative user who verified or recorded this compliance document. {@link shopping_mall_admin.id}.

plainFields.name: jurisdiction
plainFields.description: Regulatory jurisdiction code (e.g., 'GDPR-EU', 'CCPA-CA', 'Tax-GB') identifying the compliance standard being documented.

plainFields.name: document_type
plainFields.description: Type of compliance document (e.g., 'Data Processing Agreement', 'Privacy Policy', 'Tax Registration Certificate').

plainFields.name: document_reference
plainFields.description: Unique identifier or file reference for the compliance document (e.g., 'DOC-2026-001', 'GDPR-2026-ABCD').

plainFields.name: effective_from
plainFields.description: The date and time from which this compliance record is legally effective.

plainFields.name: effective_to
plainFields.description: The date and time until which this compliance record remains valid (null if perpetual).

plainFields.name: document_url
plainFields.description: URL to the stored document or digital certificate in the secure compliance vault.

plainFields.name: justification
plainFields.description: Detailed explanation provided by the admin or system regarding how this record demonstrates compliance with the specified jurisdiction.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when this compliance record was first created and recorded in the system.

plainFields.name: updated_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when this compliance record was last updated (only for metadata, never for document content).

plainFields.name: deleted_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when this record was marked as deleted (soft delete) for audit trail purposes. Null if active.

models.name: shopping_mall_config_history
models.description:
Historical snapshots of platform configuration changes for audit and rollback purposes.

Records point-in-time states of platform-wide settings whenever changes are made by administrators. Each entry captures the previous and current values of a configuration along with metadata about the changer and timestamp. This enables full audit trails, rollback capabilities, and historical analysis of configuration evolution.

Used to track system-wide changes including branding, payment, shipping, security parameters, and other platform configurations. The table follows append-only pattern with no updates to existing records - new snapshots are created for each configuration modification.

foreignFields.name: platform_configuration_id
foreignFields.description: Configuration being modified. {@link shopping_mall_platform_configurations.id}.

foreignFields.name: admin_id
foreignFields.description: Admin who made the configuration change. {@link shopping_mall_admin.id}.

plainFields.name: change_type
plainFields.description: Type of change performed: 'created', 'updated', or 'deleted'.

plainFields.name: old_value
plainFields.description: JSON string representation of configuration values before the change. Null for 'created' changes.

plainFields.name: new_value
plainFields.description: JSON string representation of configuration values after the change. Null only for 'deleted' changes.

plainFields.name: description
plainFields.description: Human-readable description of the change reason or context provided by the administrator.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when this configuration snapshot was created. Never updated - immutable record of change time.

plainFields.name: deleted_at
plainFields.description: Soft delete flag for compliance with audit trail requirements. Null indicates active record.

models.name: shopping_mall_data_exports
models.description:
Admin-initiated data export requests for compliance, reporting, or migration purposes.

Tracks requests made by administrators to export system data in specified formats with filters and preferences. Each record represents a single export job lifecycle from initiation to delivery. Export data is not stored directly in this table but referenced via file paths or URLs.

Exports are triggered for compliance audits, data migration, analytics reporting, or system backups. Administrators must specify format (CSV, JSON, Excel), selection filters, and delivery method. System generates the export asynchronously and records the outcome.

Export jobs may fail due to resource constraints, invalid filters, or system errors. Successful exports are delivered via email attachment or secure S3 link with optional encryption for sensitive data.

foreignFields.name: admin_id
foreignFields.description: Admin user who initiated this export request. {@link shopping_mall_admin.id}.

plainFields.name: request_metadata
plainFields.description: Additional JSON metadata about the export request (e.g., custom filters, advanced options). Store as serialized JSON string.

plainFields.name: format
plainFields.description: Target export format (CSV, JSON, Excel). Valid values: 'csv', 'json', 'excel'.

plainFields.name: requested_fields
plainFields.description: Comma-separated list of fields requested for export (e.g., 'id,email,created_at,order_total').

plainFields.name: filters
plainFields.description: JSON string encoding filters applied to data (e.g., status='completed', date_range='2024-01-01..2024-12-31').

plainFields.name: status
plainFields.description: Current status of the export request. Valid values: 'requested', 'processing', 'completed', 'failed', 'delivered'.

plainFields.name: delivery_method
plainFields.description: Method used to deliver the exported file. Valid values: 'email', 's3', 'download_url'.

plainFields.name: email
plainFields.description: Email address to which the exported file was sent (if delivery_method='email').

plainFields.name: file_path
plainFields.description: Full S3 filepath where the exported file is stored (if delivery_method='s3').

plainFields.name: download_url
plainFields.description: Temporary secure URL to download the exported file (if delivery_method='download_url').

plainFields.name: encrypted
plainFields.description: Whether the exported file was encrypted for security purposes.

plainFields.name: encryption_key_reference
plainFields.description: Reference ID for the encryption key used (if encrypted=true). Links to key management system.

plainFields.name: encrypted_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the file was encrypted (if encrypted=true).

plainFields.name: completed_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the export generation completed successfully.

plainFields.name: failed_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the export failed (if status='failed').

plainFields.name: delivered_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the file was successfully delivered or made available for download.

plainFields.name: error_message
plainFields.description: Detailed error message explaining why the export failed (if status='failed').

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when this export request was created.

plainFields.name: updated_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when this export record was last updated.

plainFields.name: deleted_at
plainFields.description: Soft delete timestamp, used to mark records as logically deleted without purging.

models.name: shopping_mall_monitoring_alerts
models.description:
System-generated alerts triggered by anomalies including inventory errors, fraud detection, and performance thresholds.

Tracks critical system events that require administrative attention, serving as a monitoring and alerting layer for platform governance. Alerts are immutable system-generated events that are consumed through administrative dashboards and reports, not user-managed entities.

Each alert includes type, severity, message, affected entity context, and timestamps for detection and resolution. The system automatically generates alerts based on predefined thresholds and anomaly detection rules, creating an audit trail for operational oversight and incident response.

foreignFields.name: admin_id
foreignFields.description: Admin who resolved this alert, if applicable. {@link shopping_mall_admin.id}.

plainFields.name: alert_type
plainFields.description: Category of the alert (e.g., 'low_inventory', 'fraud_attempt', 'payment_timeout'). Must be one of predefined system alert types for consistent categorization.

plainFields.name: severity
plainFields.description: Criticality level of the alert ('low', 'medium', 'high', 'critical'). Determines priority for administrative response and escalation paths.

plainFields.name: message
plainFields.description: Detailed description of the alert including error codes, context, and system-generated diagnostic information.

plainFields.name: entity_type
plainFields.description: Type of system entity affected by the alert (e.g., 'product_variant', 'order', 'payment', 'user', 'system').

plainFields.name: entity_id
plainFields.description: ID of the specific system entity affected by this alert, if applicable (e.g., product_variant_id, order_id). {@link shopping_mall_product_variants.id} or other relevant entity. Null when alert is system-wide.

plainFields.name: detected_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the alert was detected by monitoring systems. This represents the moment the anomaly was identified.

plainFields.name: resolved_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the alert was resolved or acknowledged by an admin. Null if still active. Indicates duration of alert exposure.

plainFields.name: metadata
plainFields.description: JSON string containing additional structured context about the alert (e.g., thresholds breached, metrics values, system state). For machine-readable details beyond the message field.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when this alert record was created in the database. Always matches detected_at but represents database insertion time.

plainFields.name: updated_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when this alert record was last updated (typically when resolved). Used for change tracking and audit.

models.name: shopping_mall_user_flags
models.description:
User activity flags raised by admin monitoring for suspicious behavior, duplicate accounts, and policy violations.

Tracks administrative flags on customer and seller accounts when systemic anomalies, policy violations, or potential fraud are detected. Each flag represents a potential security or compliance issue requiring review by platform administrators.

Flags are created manually by admins during monitoring activities or automatically by system alerts. They link to the specific user account being flagged and capture the reason, type, and current status of the flag. This table enables comprehensive monitoring, audit trails, and targeted investigations by the security team.

foreignFields.name: flagged_by_admin_id
foreignFields.description: The administrator who created this flag. {@link shopping_mall_admin.id}.

foreignFields.name: flagged_customer_id
foreignFields.description: The customer account that was flagged. {@link shopping_mall_customers.id}.

foreignFields.name: flagged_seller_id
foreignFields.description: The seller account that was flagged. {@link shopping_mall_sellers.id}.

plainFields.name: actor_type
plainFields.description: Type of actor being flagged: 'customer' or 'seller'. Used to determine which foreign key field contains the targeted entity.

plainFields.name: flag_type
plainFields.description: Category of the flag - e.g., 'duplicate_account', 'fraudulent_activity', 'policy_violation', 'suspicious_behavior', 'inappropriate_content'.

plainFields.name: description
plainFields.description: Detailed description of the flagged activity, including observations, evidence, and context for investigation.

plainFields.name: status
plainFields.description: Current status of the flag: 'active', 'resolved', or 'cancelled'. Only active flags are considered for operational purposes.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when this flag was created by the admin.

plainFields.name: updated_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when this flag was last updated (e.g., status change).

plainFields.name: deleted_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when this flag was removed from active monitoring (soft delete). If null, flag remains active.
